about:
Alaska Automotive operates as a Napa Auto Care Center in Palmer, Alaska. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources.

The business provides automotive repair and maintenance services, backed by the Napa Auto Care “Peace of Mind” warranty that covers qualified parts and labor for 24 months or 24,000 miles. Alaska Automotive explicitly states that it does not warranty parts supplied by customers or used parts of any kind. Details such as facility size, headcount, or service volumes are not provided.

The center serves individual vehicle owners in the Palmer area and, through the Napa network, honors its warranty at any of the 14,000 certified Napa Auto Care Centers nationwide. Its customer base consists primarily of retail automotive consumers rather than industrial or OEM clients.

The company’s stated differentiation rests on the Napa-backed warranty and the nationwide service network that allows customers to obtain warranty service across the country. No other unique capabilities or founding motivations are described in the source material.
